groups.defaults: Omitted or undefined options do not enable either feature.

groups.title: Page content replacement
groups.scope: Original-world document replacement, exact UTF-16 content, navigation timeouts and lifecycle waits, child retirement, resident assertions, private console boundary and original-call trace snapshots; Bun and Node 22/24 differential plus packed Bun ESM/CommonJS consumers.
groups.limitations: Page only; Frame.setContent remains unimplemented. Maximum 1000000 UTF-16 code units and 128 pending replacement markers per page. Existing cross-process networkidle and artifact bounds apply. Current full-core, native Linux, release and E2E performance gates remain open.
groups.defaults: waitUntil=load; navigation timeout hierarchy; timeout=0 removes the public timeout. Original URL, origin and surviving main-frame handles are preserved.
differences: A cancelled queued write whose browser completion cannot be proven retires its original page to prevent a late mutation. A timeout waiting for resources after a completed write leaves the page usable.

groups.title: Page request waits
groups.scope: String/glob/RegExp and sync/async Request predicates, baseURL, original request identity and redirects, pre-response observation, deadlines, callback errors and page/context closure; native Linux x64/Bun 1.4.2 differential and packed ESM/CommonJS runtime/types.
groups.limitations: Existing network event delivery limits apply. No new worker or remote-frame coverage. Focused slice only; Node 22/24, macOS, current full-core, release and performance gates remain open.
groups.defaults: Existing page/context general timeout hierarchy; explicit timeout wins and timeout=0 is unbounded. Listeners arm at invocation and the returned object is the original Request.
differences: S4.p: a wait started after page closure rejects immediately with TargetClosedError; pinned Playwright 1.60.0 waits for its finite timeout. This is not an equivalent-work speed claim.

groups.title: Browser context media preferences
groups.scope: Immutable colorScheme, reducedMotion, forcedColors and contrast in ordinary newContext/newPage, plus runner contextOptions and individual colorScheme. Shared initial-script, application-script, navigation, CSS, child-frame, isolation, null/undefined and malformed-value cases pass on Linux. Full Chrome exercises actual out-of-process children; packed ESM/CommonJS consumers verify declarations and runtime values.
groups.limitations: Native Linux x64 development coverage. Headless shell children remained in-process. Node 22 has focused library differential coverage; the complete headless-shell core and packed gates use Bun 1.4.2. Current full-Chrome media and runner cases passed. The latest complete full-Chrome attempt failed at separate-browser reference touch inheritance, so that complete gate remains open. Native macOS, page-level emulateMedia, persistent contexts, remote user init scripts, release and comparative performance acceptance remain separate.
groups.defaults: Omitted preferences select light, no-preference, none and no-preference respectively. Null removes a feature override and inherits the browser environment. Chromium colorScheme no-preference can also follow the environment. Explicit undefined on manual runner contexts suppresses inherited values. Individual runner colorScheme overrides contextOptions; the other three preferences use contextOptions.
